summary: Recent updates to the Web Speech functionality in Firefox include improvements to handle audio sessions more effectively. The changes prevent the Web Speech API, which allows for voice recognition and speech synthesis, from starting automatically when the audio session is interrupted. This ensures a smoother user experience during voice interactions, as interruptions won't accidentally trigger speech input. Additionally, the removal of an outdated component related to upload streams helps streamline the underlying architecture of the browser. These refinements are essential for maintaining a reliable and responsive voice interface.
